detail.statement: Preference stability in autonomous agents is significantly influenced by path-dependent memory accumulation, even when scalarized reward signals appear static.
detail.reason: Previous experimental variance measurements (exp-mem-pref-14) were inconclusive, necessitating a synthesis of existing experiential memory findings to progress on commitment commit-mem-pref-10.

children.title: Cycle 114 · Synthesis of Preference Stability and Identity Persistence

detail.title: Synthesis of Preference Stability and Identity Persistence
detail.summary: This cycle focuses on synthesizing experiential memory findings for project proj-mem-pref-01 and establishing formal definitions for identity persistence metrics under project proj-mem-id-01. Given inconclusive experimental variance measurements, the approach shifts toward theoretical synthesis.
